mn144:10.2: What have you seen in the ear, ear consciousness …
mn144:10.6: What have you seen, what have you directly known in the mind, mind consciousness, and things knowable by mind consciousness that you regard them in this way: ‘This is not mine, I am not this, this is not my self’?”
mn144:10.8: After seeing cessation in the ear, ear consciousness …
mn144:10.12: After seeing cessation, after directly knowing cessation in the mind, mind consciousness, and things knowable by mind consciousness, I regard them in this way: ‘This is not mine, I am not this, this is not my self’.”
